description:
As a QA Engineer
  I want to interact with static and dynamic dropdowns
  So that I can validate value selection, label selection, and auto-suggest behaviors

elements.name: Select an option from a static dropdown by Value

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I select the option with value "option1" from the static dropdown
the static dropdown should display the text "Option1"

elements.name: Select an option from a static dropdown by visible Label

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I select the option with label "Option2" from the static dropdown
the static dropdown should display the text "Option2"

elements.name: Change selection in a static dropdown (Override)

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I select the option with label "Option1" from the static dropdown
I select the option with label "Option3" from the static dropdown
the static dropdown should display the text "Option3"

elements.name: Type and select exact match in dynamic auto-suggest dropdown

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I type "India" into the dynamic country dropdown
I wait for the auto-suggest list to populate
I select "India" from the dynamic suggestion list
the dynamic dropdown input should contain the value "India"

elements.name: Type partial match and select from dynamic auto-suggest list

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I type "ind" into the dynamic country dropdown
I wait for the auto-suggest list to populate
I select "Indonesia" from the dynamic suggestion list
the dynamic dropdown input should contain the value "Indonesia"

elements.name: Clear dynamic dropdown and search again

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I type "USA" into the dynamic country dropdown
I clear the dynamic country dropdown manually
I type "India" into the dynamic country dropdown
I wait for the auto-suggest list to populate
I select "India" from the dynamic suggestion list
the dynamic dropdown input should contain the value "India"

elements.name: Navigate dynamic dropdown using keyboard controls

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I type "uni" into the dynamic country dropdown
I wait for the auto-suggest list to populate
I press the "ArrowDown" key 2 times
I press the "Enter" key
the dynamic dropdown input should not be empty

name: Dropdown Interactions

description:
As a QA Engineer
  I want to interact with various input fields
  So that I can validate text input behaviour

elements.name: Type text into a simple input field

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://practice.expandtesting.com/inputs'
I fill the number input with "42"
I click the "Display Inputs" button
the number output should have value "42"

elements.name: Type text into the Text input

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://practice.expandtesting.com/inputs'
I fill the text input with "Test Data"
I click the "Display Inputs" button
the text output should have value "Test Data"

elements.name: Select a date in the Date input

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://practice.expandtesting.com/inputs'
I fill the date input with "2025-06-15"
I click the "Display Inputs" button
the date output should have value "2025-06-15"

elements.name: Fill all inputs and display them together

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://practice.expandtesting.com/inputs'
I fill the number input with "10"
I fill the text input with "Playwright"
I fill the date input with "2025-01-01"
I click the "Display Inputs" button
the number output should have value "10"
the text output should have value "Playwright"
the date output should have value "2025-01-01"

elements.name: Clear all inputs using the Clear button

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://practice.expandtesting.com/inputs'
I fill the text input with "ToBeCleared"
I fill the number input with "999"
I click the "Clear Inputs" button
the text output should not be visible
the number output should not be visible

elements.name: Manually clear a single input and retype

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://practice.expandtesting.com/inputs'
I fill the text input with "OldText"
I fill the text input with "NewText"
I clear the text input manually
the text output should not be visible
the number output should not be visible

name: Input Field Interactions

description:
As a QA Engineer
  I want to interact with various radio buttons and checkboxes
  So that I can validate selection, toggling, and state transition behaviors

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I select the "radio1" radio button
the "radio1" radio button should be checked
the "radio2" radio button should not be checked
I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I select the "radio1" radio button
I select the "radio2" radio button
the "radio2" radio button should be checked
the "radio1" radio button should not be checked
I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I check the "option1" checkbox
the "option1" checkbox should be checked
I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I check the "option1" checkbox
I check the "option2" checkbox
I check the "option3" checkbox
the "option1" checkbox should be checked
the "option2" checkbox should be checked
the "option3" checkbox should be checked

elements.name: Toggle a checkbox state manually (Check and Uncheck)

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I check the "option1" checkbox
the "option1" checkbox should be checked
I uncheck the "option1" checkbox
the "option1" checkbox should be unchecked

elements.name: Check all available checkboxes dynamically (Bulk Action)

steps.name: I open the browser and go to 'https://rahulshettyacademy.com/AutomationPractice/'
I check all the checkboxes on the page
all checkboxes should be in a checked state

name: Radio Button and Checkbox Interactions
